dataset.funding_source: venue fundingRate archives inside the same verified tape, settlement instant = funding_time_ms

holdout.reason: already sealed before E-001; nothing in this registration opens it

execution_model.entry: MARKET at the next bar open after the first bar closing at or after the funding settlement
execution_model.exit: static bracket, stop 2% / target 4% of entry, stop-first intrabar, 48-bar time exit
execution_model.funding: actual venue settlements inside the holding window
execution_model.sizing: risk 100 USDT per campaign; R = net PnL / 100

candidates.statement: An extreme settlement funding rate marks leveraged crowding, and the crowded side reverses over the following holding window by more than the round-trip cost and more than a matched random entry.
candidates.direction_rule: rate strictly below the trailing 10th percentile -> LONG; strictly above the trailing 90th percentile -> SHORT
candidates.tie_rule: strict comparisons only, so the modal constant rate never triggers
candidates.falsified_by: net expectancy <= 0, or not above the matched random-entry control, or concentration in fewer than 6 of 10 symbols

random_entry_matched_exits.pool: every bar from warmup to the penultimate bar, both directions, identical bracket, costs, funding and time exit
random_entry_matched_exits.draw_rule: per symbol, sample without replacement exactly the candidate's trade count; pooled statistic is the mean of per-symbol draw means

unit_of_comparison: per-campaign net R; cross-market clustering unit is the per-symbol mean net R
secondary_metrics: control percentile and one-sided control p-value

gates.multiple_testing: Holm over the hypotheses in this family (one primary)

decision_rule: DEV_CANDIDATE only when every gate passes; otherwise NO_EDGE, or INCONCLUSIVE below the trade minimum. DEV_CANDIDATE nominates a native validation and is not an economic edge claim. PASS can never be awarded by this screen.

cumulative_dev_budget.note: The development window is exploratory by design: it can nominate, never confirm. Only a frozen candidate evaluated on the sealed holdout can support a claim.

known_limitations: funding is a crowding proxy; open interest and positioning are absent from the archives
the funding series is settlement-frequency (8h) while entries are hourly, so at most three entry opportunities per day per symbol
the bar path does not model queue position or partial fills
dev and holdout share one six-month regime
